correctness.rationale: A shortest-cycle argument for induced equitable quotient cycles proves preservation of the Woodroofe forbidden-cycle class. Group-orbit partitions are equitable after deleting internally adjacent orbits. Positive barycentric supports give the exact PL model of geometric fixed points. Woodroofe 2008 Theorem 1 supplies vertex decomposability and nonpure shelling supplies the homotopy wedge. Verified 1695 independent equitable partitions and 3633 actions on eligible graphs (906 inputs) with 24273 exact face comparisons; finite evidence is corroborative only.
